name: agent-office
description: A pixel-art office in a pane: every running subagent is a worker at a desk, with a live label for what it is doing.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane automatically
autoOpen.description: Open the office the first time a subagent starts.

autoAspect.title: Measure the terminal's cell size
autoAspect.description: On by default: the plugin reads the terminal's size in pixels (a read-only call made through a one-line perl command) so the pictures fit exactly, whatever the font. Turn it off to use the cell aspect setting below.

cellAspect.title: Terminal cell height / width
cellAspect.description: Used when the cell size cannot be measured, or when measuring is off: how many times taller a character cell is than it is wide, between 1 and 4. Raise it a little if there is a bar under each picture, lower it if the pictures look squashed.

detail.title: Picture detail
detail.description: auto picks by office size, normal is lighter, high is sharper.

display.title: How the office is drawn
display.description: auto draws the picture with live labels where the terminal can show images (kitty, Ghostty, iTerm2 3.5 or later, in fullscreen, not under tmux) and a text list elsewhere. image and text force one of them.
